steps.claim: Assemble: for each i ≤ ϱ, the arrow product of the combinations for Υ_{2i}, Υ_{2i+1} (map_bilinear) is a combination of arrow products of vacuum translates, re-indexed by translations; its image under pairEvalY(i) is, by hC_i, a combination of C_i·τ_N(pairs of translated vacua) (bind). Tensoring over i (IsAdmissibleComb.pure, denominator cutBound⁴ per factor) and identifying pure tensors of C_i·τ_N(…) with C·D.reducedVacuum(t) (pure_smul) gives the claim, with 4(ϱ + 1) = 2m. Several goals remain.

    a).of_eq_isOfFinOrder_smul fun y hy ↦ ?_).map (D.pairEvalY i)).bind _ _ (hC i (by omega) _ _

steps.claim: Re-indexing: the arrow product of two vacuum translates is a root of unity (a power of a value of ψ_f) times the translate at the combined vector (−ε·ȳ on the first block, y on the second). It lies in weightedTranslations(q, selfOrConj(π̄_g)), the input set of the admissible evaluation hC_i (β = π̄_g with its default weights selfOrConj(β)): weight π̄_g on the conjugated first block (star_mem_weightedTranslations: conjugating a vector of translations(q, π_g) conjugates its weight) and weight π_g on the unconjugated second block. A common weight π̄_g on the whole vector would lose the conjugation.
steps.lean:

    r.1.elim (fun i ↦ -Weil.normNegOne.1.1 * star (y.1 (r.2, i))) (y.2 ⟨·, r.2⟩), Prod.rec (Sum.rec
    (fun i l ↦ star_star (_ : 𝔸f D.E) ▸ star_mem_weightedTranslations (neg_mem Weil.normNegOne.1.2)
    hy.1 id (l, i)) fun _ _ ↦ hy.2 _), by simp [eq_inv_smul_iff₀, ← arrowProduct_vacElem,
    finHeisOp_arrowProduct, mul_left_comm Weil.normNegOne.1.1, ← mul_assoc]; rfl⟩
